QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Back to Lith Harbor
QuestInfo.0: Your long and arduous journey at Commerci Republic has come to an end. It's time for you to return to Ereve. Speak to Leon to board a Lith Harbor-bound ship.
QuestInfo.1: Your long and arduous journey at Commerci Republic has come to an end. Leon provided you passage on a ship bound for Lith Harbor.
QuestInfo.2: Your long and arduous journey at Commerci Republic came to an end. You returned to Lith Harbor on a ship provided by Leon to find Parbell the Explorer waiting for you.

0.0: We're all ready to set sail. Did you get everything?

yes.0: All right, time to take off! Our destination: Maple World!

no.0: We've got a little time left. Make sure you're all set!
